pointers.to: render model instance (all draw-side setters forward to it)
bucket array of the virtual-joint hash map (nodes: next +0x0, hash +0x8, Hash40 +0x10, value after)

notes: Most exported setters (alpha, emissive, depth, render offset, visibility, mesh visibility) only forward to the render model at +0x10 and keep no state in the module. State kept in the module: scale (+0x30), scale_z (+0x34), rotation_order (+0x40), colors, fade blocks, gold-eye flags, joint caches. scale and scale_z feed the joint/hitbox positions (joint_global_position paths read +0x34/+0x38/+0x90), so they are simulation state; the colors, fades, gold-eye flags and model pointer are presentation. Exports with null slots dispatch: joint_global_position +0x150, joint_global_position_with_offset +0x158, joint_global_rotation +0x180, joint_global_axis +0x188, set_joint_translate +0x1A8, set_visibility +0x1C0, set_mesh_visibility +0x1D0. Names marked with a number suffix were not tied to an export.
